subject.title: fix(ollama): dripping model pulls hang past idle timeout during setup

question: Should Ollama onboarding treat 300 seconds of streamed data without any increase in aggregate completed as a failed pull for all supported Ollama endpoints?
rationale: The patch fixes an indefinite setup hang, but upstream documents progress fields without promising their cadence, so tests cannot decide the compatibility policy for unusual local, remote, proxied, shared, or older Ollama servers.

options.title: Approve semantic fail-closed
options.body: Accept the current 300-second no-progress watchdog while allowing advancing pulls to run without a total lifetime cap.

options.title: Preserve active-stream waiting
options.body: Keep only header and byte-idle timeouts, leaving non-advancing status drips alive until user cancellation.

options.title: Narrow supported endpoints
options.body: Approve the watchdog only after defining and testing a narrower supported Ollama version or endpoint contract.

recommendation.title: Approve semantic fail-closed
recommendation.body: Accept the current 300-second no-progress watchdog while allowing advancing pulls to run without a total lifetime cap.

likelyOwner.reason: BruceMacD introduced the onboarding auto-pull behavior and is best positioned to define its intended failure boundary.
